text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin reflects on the many ways she differs from her friends—from their upbringings, attitudes toward life, and running styles, down to their reasons for running and why others support them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells me she runs because that's what she wants to do, and I tell her that's reason enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't want her to focus on what people want from her—I just want to see her racing eagerly, happily, and freely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My plain and simple encouragement gets through to her. I know well that my support will help her. It's time for us to enjoy the autumn Tenno Sho to the fullest!
